reply.text:
Honestly, it depends on how you feel, and one bad night doesn't wreck a body. If you do train, keep it easier than planned: drop a set or two from the main lifts, leave more reps in the tank, and skip anything max-effort or technically sharp, since reaction time and judgment are the first things to slip.

If you feel wrecked, a walk or an early night does more for you than a grinder session. Sleep is where the training pays off anyway.

I can build you a lighter session for today if you'd like.
